postLoadActionList: Load all player decks before loading the scenario.

handSize._comment: When a card enters play or flips, if it has a hand size, set the player's hand size to that value plus the applicable modifier.

heroHandSizeModifierChanged._comment: When heroHandSizeModifier changes, recalculate hand size if the hero side is currently up.

alterEgoHandSizeModifierChanged._comment: When alterEgoHandSizeModifier changes, recalculate hand size if the alter ego side is currently up.

setSideSchemeStartingThreat._comment: When a side scheme enters play set starting threat

setFlippedSideSchemeStartingThreat._comment: When a side scheme is flipped face up set starting threat

playerDeckEmptied._comment: When a player deck empties, give them an encounter deck and shuffle the deck.

encounterDeckEmptied._comment: When the encounter deck empties, add an acceleration token and shuffle the deck.

encounter2DeckEmptied._comment: When the second encounter deck empties, shuffle the deck.
then: Second Encounter Deck has been emptied.
Second Encounter Deck has been reshuffled.

resetCardLeavesPlay._comment: Reset card when it leaves play

toughness._comment: When a card is flipped face up add tough to a card with toughness

uses._comment: When a card with Uses enters play faceup, initialize its generic tokens

usesOnFlip._comment: When a card with Uses is flipped faceup, initialize its generic tokens if not already set

ironManTechHandSize._comment: When cards enter/leave play or change controller, recalculate Iron Man's heroHandSizeModifier based on Tech upgrades controlled (up to +6).

starLordHelmetHandSize._comment: When cards enter/leave play or change groups, recalculate Star-Lord's heroHandSizeModifier based on facedown encounter cards engaged (up to +3).

controllerIdentityHitPoints._comment: When a card with identityHitPointsModifier enters/leaves play, flips, or changes controller, update the controlling player's hit points.

engagedMinionHandSize._comment: When a minion with hand size modifiers enters/leaves play, flips, or changes groups (becomes engaged/disengaged), update the engaged player's hand size modifiers.

controllerHandSize._comment: When a non-minion card with heroHandSizeModifier or alterEgoHandSizeModifier enters/leaves play, flips, or changes controller, update the controlling player's hand size modifiers.

globalHandSize._comment: When a card with globalHandSizeModifier enters/leaves play or flips, update each player's hand size modifiers.
